caption: The drawing depicts a single cream-colored ceramic jar positioned centrally within a thin rectangular border. The jar has a wide cylindrical body that tapers slightly toward the base, with a narrower, flared opening at the top. Two short, curved handles are attached symmetrically on opposite sides near the jar's shoulder. The interior of the jar is a darker, brownish tone, visible from the top opening. On the front side of the jar, slightly to the left, there is a blue line drawing of an eight-pointed star containing the number "3" inside a circle at its center. The surface of the jar displays subtle shading and variations in tone, suggesting areas of light reflection and wear, with a darker, somewhat stained area near the base. The artist's name, "MAGNUS S. FOSSUM," is inscribed in small capital letters near the lower left outside the jar, inside the border. The background is plain and pale, with no other objects present.
title: Churn
cluster: #19 — Ceramic Arts: Pottery, Stoneware, and Porcelain
